# A query in a component built at run time, its fetch a named function that
# waits, on every target.
#
# The query is the instance, so `fetch` stayed its prop, and a call through
# a prop is colored by nothing: html read the Promise the fetch returned as
# the answer, fyne and gtk4 fetched on the drawing thread
# (testdata/async_query_fetch_prop.txtar shows the goroutine), and android's
# composable took `::fetchBook`, a suspend function, as a plain one and did
# not compile. A prop a call site hands a function that waits is now typed as
# one (passAsyncProps), and Kotlin spells that type `suspend`.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import http "sngl:http"
import json "sngl:json"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

const server = "http://127.0.0.1:47819"

struct Book {
    title string
}

// A book, asked of the harness's server.
func fetchBook(title string) async.Result[Book] {
    match var r = http.get(url="{server}/books/{http.pathEscape(title)}") {
        failed { return {failed=r} }
        ok {
            match var checked = r.checked() {
                failed { return {failed=checked} }
                ok { return json.decode[Book](checked.body) }
            }
        }
    }
}

component page ui.node {
    var tab = 0
    var loads = 0
    var kind = "Red"

    ui.tabs #tabs(:selected=tab) {
        ui.tab(label="First") {
            ui.text(value="first")
        }
        ui.tab(label="Second") {
            ui.vbox {
                for var title = ["dune", "war and peace"] {
                    async.query(on=title, fetch=fetchBook, @load(got) { loads += 1 })
                }
                ui.select #pick(:value=kind) {
                    ui.choice(label="Red")
                    ui.choice(label="Green")
                }
                ui.text #count(value="{loads}")
            }
        }
    }
}

ui.window {
    page()
}

func testEachBookIsAskedForOnce(t test.Test, c page) {
    c.tabs.change(1)
    t.wait(func() => c.loads >= 2, 5000)
    t.wait(func() => c.loads > 2, 1000)
    t.assert(c.loads == 2)
    t.assert(c.count != null && c.count.value == "2")
}
